title: PDFweave production feature qualification
description: A traceable map from supported production features to executable tests and inspectable PDF evidence.

scenarios.title: Paper size catalog
scenarios.description: Eight physical sheets covering A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, Letter, Legal, and a custom millimeter size.

scenarios.title: Scale and alignment catalog
scenarios.description: Rendered contain, cover, none, upscale, alignment, clipping, and auto-rotation cases.

scenarios.title: Source box catalog
scenarios.description: Media, crop, bleed, trim, and art boxes plus a visible trim-to-crop fallback case.

scenarios.title: Rotation catalog
scenarios.description: A 2x2 sheet containing source pages with intrinsic 0, 90, 180, and 270 degree rotations.

scenarios.title: Fill order and collation catalog
scenarios.description: Row-major, column-major, collated-copy, and uncollated-copy output sequences.

scenarios.title: Imposition source-Form resource reuse
scenarios.description: Twelve placements across three sheets reuse exactly two unique embedded source-page Form XObjects, with one source load and one embedPages call.

scenarios.title: Seven-page boleto component book
scenarios.description: Seven distinct, structured cobranca test records rendered as complete 200 x 95 mm boleto specimens with normal typography, scan-validated ITF barcodes, scan-validated synthetic Pix QR codes, fixed instruction lanes, and a non-payable watermark. The records are not bank-issued, certified, or homologated.

scenarios.title: 170 mm minimum-width boleto
scenarios.description: One structured 170 x 95 mm boleto specimen whose normal-font linha digitavel is horizontally condensed without reducing its 14 pt vertical size, with barcode decoding and printed-height checks at 300 DPI.

scenarios.title: Boleto over asymmetric CropBox stationery
scenarios.description: A validated boleto is printed at an authored top-left position over a dark patterned base PDF whose visible CropBox is offset asymmetrically inside a nonzero MediaBox. The boleto receives an opaque white backing while the surrounding stationery remains unchanged.

scenarios.title: A4 boleto exact-size 2-up job
scenarios.description: Seven validated, visibly watermarked 200 x 95 mm boleto test specimens packed without scaling two-up across four A4 sheets, with a Pix QR decoded after imposition and one explicit empty slot on the final sheet.

scenarios.title: Landscape A3 boleto exact-size 4-up job
scenarios.description: Seven validated, visibly watermarked 200 x 95 mm boleto test specimens packed without scaling four-up across two landscape A3 sheets, with a Pix QR decoded after imposition and one explicit empty slot on the final sheet.

scenarios.title: Landscape A3 statement 4-up job
scenarios.description: Five A5 client statements packed four-up across two landscape A3 sheets.

scenarios.title: Multi-page invoice
scenarios.description: A three-page A4 invoice with fixed percentage columns, wrapped long descriptions, automatically enlarged rows, repeated headings, and terminal subtotal, tax, and total rows.

scenarios.title: Multi-page bank extract
scenarios.description: A three-page A4 bank extract with running balances and a terminal closing-balance row.

scenarios.title: 100 client invoice statements
scenarios.description: One 100-page A4 PDF with unique client, invoice, date, service, and amount data while the constant logo and font are embedded once.

scenarios.title: 100 boleto records with one shared logo
scenarios.description: One 100-page PDF receives 100 distinct validated boleto inputs while embedding the constant institution logo once. Every page renders distinct ITF and synthetic Pix identifiers under a non-payable watermark.

features.name: Boleto cobranca data and check-digit validation

assertions: Published Itau and Banco do Brasil barcode vectors derive and format to their expected 47-digit lines.
Corrupt check digits and cross-field mismatches fail with stable boleto-prefixed errors.
Numeric and uppercase alphanumeric CNPJ values have executable check-digit coverage.
Known institution display suffixes include Sicredi's uppercase X and are cross-checked before rendering.
Fixed and variable amount modes, the 2025 due-factor reset, and factor 0000 without an encoded due date have executable boundary coverage.
Fixed discounts and interest reconcile exactly to the charged amount; impossible totals and adjustment fields on variable-amount records fail closed.
Third-party collection rejects a final-beneficiary CPF/CNPJ equal to the payer after punctuation normalization.
Every displayed boleto in the linked PDF is generated from a distinct structured input object, not from decorative fixture drawing.

features.name: Boleto ficha de compensacao component
features.definition: One structured boleto value renders the supported ficha de compensacao layout. Registered mode always renders the formatted line and specification-shaped ITF barcode. Test mode safely redacts identifiers by default, while an explicit qualification-only render policy exposes synthetic identifiers under an unavoidable non-payable watermark.
assertions: The component draws one exact 103 x 13 mm ITF barcode and produces a reloadable PDF.
The institution code, digitable line, and mechanical-authentication caption use ordinary text primitives in both PDF and browser paths rather than a custom SVG stroke alphabet.

PDFweave's deterministic 0.3 mm project grid keeps outer ink inside the ficha and merges shared internal cell edges; this regression choice is not presented as a separately mandated FEBRABAN dimension.
Every text, image, line, and barcode primitive stays within the supported minimum and maximum ficha dimensions.
The layout uses the three Annex III adjustment rows, a dedicated final-beneficiary line, and the accented Portuguese field labels.
The plugin is output-only and requires a complete structured value supplied through binding.
The seven-page book contains distinct payer, document, amount, barcode, and Pix values while omitting the identifier values from manifests.

The public 300 DPI verifier recovers every exact ITF payload and checks guards, run clusters, wide-to-narrow ratio, quiet zones, and digitable-line geometry at both the 200 mm artifact width and the supported 170 mm minimum.
Synthetic qualification pages carry an unavoidable non-payable watermark and are described as standards-aligned test specimens, never as bank-certified output.

features.name: Validated Pix QR and fixed instruction lanes
features.definition: An issuer-supplied complete Pix BR Code payload can be placed explicitly at the right of the beneficiary-instructions block. Up to three 180-character instructions retain independent vertical lanes, so wrapping or shrinking one logical line never moves later lines.
assertions: The Pix parser validates character-counted EMV TLV structure, a UTF-8 CRC16-CCITT-FALSE checksum, payload format 01, exactly one br.gov.bcb.pix merchant account, MCC, BRL currency 986, country BR, merchant name/city, and the additional-data reference label.
Static key and dynamic URL merchant data are mutually exclusive; an optional point-of-initiation method must agree with that classification.
The exact static and dynamic example payloads published by BCB parse with their documented CRCs and classifications.
A static Pix amount must exactly match documentValueCents; a dynamic root amount is ignored because the URL response is authoritative.
PDF and browser paths render a 20.7 mm EC-M QR from the exact structurally validated payload and measure at least four quiet modules on every side of the emitted SVG path.
Module-count preflight accepts at most a 49 x 49 version-8 matrix, preserving at least four printer dots per module at 300 DPI; denser payloads fail before PDF drawing.
The exact BCB-published static and dynamic vectors measure 45 and 49 modules, and the 300 DPI artifact decoder recovers every exact synthetic payload from the published PDF pages.
Three unbroken 180-character instructions preflight and render at the minimum 170 mm width, with and without Pix; a fourth lane or 181st character is rejected.
Placement is explicit and remains subject to the issuing bank's profile and homologation; the component does not accept an arbitrary image, raw Pix key, or naked dynamic URL as a compliant Pix QR.

features.name: Boleto fail-closed render preflight
features.definition: Invalid structured values, unsafe ficha geometry, unrenderable text, and malformed or oversized embedded logos are rejected by preflight before any PDF page drawing operation.
assertions: Ficha size, rotation, opacity, variant, and non-negative position constraints fail with stable errors.
A ficha extending beyond the physical PDF page is rejected before lines or barcode graphics are drawn.
Text that cannot fit at the minimum font size is rejected rather than silently clipped.

Institution logo bytes are fully decoded before rendering; animated PNG control chunks are rejected before UPNG or PngEmbedder, and truncated PNG data, truncated JPEG scan data, and JPEG metadata without a scan are rejected before PDF page drawing.
Logo preflight enforces 2,048-pixel edge and 4-megapixel limits before structural decode, plus an 8,000,000-character data-URI limit and a 64 MiB JPEG decoder allocation cap.
Only the tested PDF preflight rejection paths are draw-free; callers must discard the document after a later embedding or drawing rejection.
Browser rendering validates before staging and atomically commits either a complete component or one stable error marker.
The linked book is the valid visual boundary; rejection cases intentionally produce no PDF.
